strategies.name: Behavioral Detection of Visual Basic Execution in ICS

analytics.name: Analytic 2091
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies wscript.exe/cscript.exe, Office macro, or HTA-driven Visual Basic execution from unexpected parents/paths or followed by PowerShell, command shell, network activity, or system modification. Alert only when the interpreter is not part of the asset's approved software/automation baseline or its execution context violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/user rule, and require OT-relevant corroboration such as access to engineering files, ICS software/API use, communications with protected OT assets, configuration change, or another suspicious follow-on behavior. Suppress documented vendor software, engineering workflows, diagnostics, backup, patching, and approved maintenance.
